data.description:
Umbrella remediation ticket for the 2026-06-04 deep code review. THE SPEC IS THE REVIEW FILE: reviews/2026-06-04-deep-code-review.md — read it first; it has file:line, verified failure scenarios, and refuted non-bugs (do not re-fix those).

Scope (10 confirmed findings + 4 below-cut):
1. Recovery falsely orphans LIVE idle sessions — capture PID at session_start, wire the liveness check (recovery.go:129; absorbs ETCH-30)
2. findRepoRoot()=os.Getwd() → silent session loss — resolve git common-dir root at the hook boundary (hooks/common.go:39; supersedes-in-part ETCH-34)
3. Session refs silently overwritable — create-only update-ref guard (refs/writer.go:47)
4. Duplicate session_start splits sessions — reuse existing mapping (session_start.go:38)
5. Redaction only covers Prompt.Text — full-record redaction pass at commit boundary (commit.go:24)
6. local_only_fields unimplemented (config.go:13; absorbs ETCH-31)
7. OpenAI key regex misses sk-proj-/sk-svcacct- (secrets.go:28; absorbs ETCH-25)
8. commitSession failure swallowed, printOK lies (session_end.go:62)
9. Recovery records falsified/lossy — share ONE wip→session reducer with Finalize (recovery.go:263; absorbs ETCH-33)
10. tokens never populated — reconcile spec vs Entire payload reality (buffer.go:159; absorbs ETCH-32)
Below-cut: gitDiffFiles rename/quotePath corruption; archive non-atomic quarter (use update-ref --stdin); ScanOrphaned O(N×M) per start (absorbs ETCH-36); mid-rune prompt truncation.

NOT absorbed (still standalone): ETCH-26/27/28/29/39 (distinct secret-scan patterns the review did not cover).

Acceptance: each fix lands with adversarial tests (hook re-delivery, idle-timeout false positive, commit-failure injection, duplicate session_start) — the review's thematic conclusion is that these paths were spec'd but never tested.

data.body:
DECISIONS (operator, 2026-06-06) for the two decision-first findings:
- Finding 6 (local_only_fields): IMPLEMENT real strip-before-push — spun out as its own ticket (see ETCH-41) since it is a design+impl project touching the refspec story. Interim: this finding is satisfied for ETCH-40 closeout by the new ticket existing and README marking the feature 'in development' until it lands.
- Finding 10 (tokens): DROP from v1 spec — amend OUTPUT_SPEC to mark tokens null-in-v1/reserved, delete the dead aggregation paths (capture + recovery), file v2 enrichment as future work. Honest null beats a number that is wrong for 7 of 8 runtimes.

Redaction batch impl complete on fix/redaction-batch (69961a1). f.5 (commit-boundary redaction): DONE — redact.DeepRedact walks every string-bearing field (incl. map keys & interface-boxed values) at BOTH commit boundaries (normal + crash recovery); e2e proves committed session.json AND agent-trace.json blobs clean. f.7 (modern OpenAI keys): DONE — sk-proj-/sk-svcacct-/sk-admin- pattern added; sk-DOCUMENTATION-NOT-A-KEY still preserved. Also lands ETCH-26 (bare AWS via len==40+mixed-class validator), ETCH-27 (JWT), ETCH-28 (full PEM block), ETCH-29 (sk-ant placeholders preserved), ETCH-39 (credential keywords). Heading to code-review.

f.2 (findRepoRoot CWD anchoring): implemented on fix/repo-root-batch (commit f869d9d) — findRepoRoot() replaced by capture.ResolveRepoContext (StateRoot=common-dir parent for .etch/settings/recovery/refs, WorkDir=checkout toplevel for git capture/diffs); all six hook subcommands resolve it first; adversarial subdir/worktree/non-git tests green. Heading into code-review.

f.5 (commit-boundary redaction): DONE in PR #17 — redact.DeepRedact full-record pass at both commit boundaries; committed-blob e2e proof (session.json + agent-trace.json, 0 leaks). f.7 (modern OpenAI keys): DONE in PR #17 — sk-proj-/sk-svcacct-/sk-admin- patterns; placeholders preserved. PR: https://forgejo.stage11.ai/s11/etch/pulls/17 (also resolves ETCH-26/27/28/29/39). Status of ETCH-40 untouched per run rules.

f.2 (findRepoRoot CWD anchoring): landed in PR #18 (https://forgejo.stage11.ai/s11/etch/pulls/18) — findRepoRoot() deleted, RepoContext(StateRoot=common-dir parent, WorkDir=checkout toplevel) threaded through all six hook subcommands; adversarial subdir/worktree/non-git tests + live e2e green; both batch tickets at pr_open.
lifecycle batch (f.1,3,4,8,9 + below-cut): entering planning. Surface surface:409, worktree fix/lifecycle-recovery.

lifecycle batch: plan written (appended to the shared ETCH-40 plan file). Spine: f.9 shared reducer first (Reduce/Finish split of Finalize; recovery rides the same path; kills flattenHookEvent + dead flat decode; tokens stay null per f.10 decision), then f.1 (ancestor-matched PID+start-time liveness; alive always vetoes recovery), f.4 (mapping reuse-guard + RecoverAll exclude), f.3 (create-only update-ref with one documented upgrade exception incomplete->complete via CAS), f.8 (exactly-once retry = retained wip + end-aware recovery + ErrRefExists no-op), below-cut (diff -z rename-aware, archive update-ref --stdin txn, stat-first scan, rune backoff). One PR planned. Entering plan-review.
